title: Vulnerabilities in Alior Bank "raty" module for PrestaShop
content_md: CERT Polska has received a report about 2 SQL Injection vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-7848 and CVE-2026-15600) found in Alior Bank “raty” module for PrestaShop. Article Link: Vulnerabilities in Alior Bank "raty" module for PrestaShop | CERT Polska
